'''Michonne Bourriague''' portrayed Aurra Sing in ''The Phantom Menace'' (podrace sequence) and was a special guest at [[DecipherCon 2000]] with [[Shannon Baksa]]. The Tatooine rare [[Aurra Sing]] and its [[Alternate Image]] [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] are the film character she played. An oversized Aurra Sing promo was given for spending $20 at the Decipher store at conventions; she signed in that trade at Kissimmee.<ref name="home">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040217015645/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/ DecipherCon 2000], Decipher (Wayback 17 February 2004)</ref><ref name="insider">''Star Wars Insider'' 52 (2000), "It's a CCG TKO When Star Wars Fans Compete at DecipherCon 2000"</ref>

[[File:DecipherCon 2000 Michonne Bourriague.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Bourriague at DecipherCon 2000, 6 October 2000]]

Mark Tuttle called her Radio Free Decipher interview from the convention "the best."<ref name="home" /> She was not on the DecipherCon '99 guest list.
